fact: Somalia's Justice Sector Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) was formally introduced at a demonstration in Mogadishu on 9 October 2025, connecting the Criminal Investigation Department, the Prosecutor's Office, the courts and prisons so that a criminal case's information is entered as a digital record in place of a paper-based manual process, under a partnership of the Federal Government with the US Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs, with IDLO as implementing partner.
title: Somalia Launches Groundbreaking Electronic Case Management System to Revolutionize Justice Sector
